title: AI Model Consensus: Champions of Fairness
description: Interactive Venn diagram comparing which historical figures four different AI models (Claude, OpenAI GPT, Grok, DeepSeek) identified as people who worked to make the world more fair. Hover over dots to see details about each person.
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Compare AI model outputs on subjective ethical topics
Identify consensus figures in fairness advocacy
Explore diversity of perspectives across AI models
